def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Equação empírica para log10(|ID|/A) ao longo da curva de transferência."""
    """Improved equation for log10(|ID|/A) in the saturation regime of a p-channel OTFT."""
    return parameters[0] + parameters[1] * gate_voltage_abs + parameters[2] * (gate_voltage_abs - parameters[3])**2 + parameters[4] * (gate_voltage_abs - parameters[3])**3
